name: Weather Widget
description: Weather card whose sky gradient and scene (rotating sun rays, drifting clouds, rain, twinkling stars) crossfade per condition.
a11y: role=group labelled with city, temperature and condition; scene is aria-hidden and frozen under reduced motion.
perf: A handful of transformed elements per scene.
prompt: Build a weather widget: rounded card with a per-condition gradient crossfading via AnimatePresence; scenes: a slowly rotating sun with 12 rays, clouds drifting across, rain streaks falling with staggered durations, twinkling stars at night; temperature and H/L text on top.

name: Now Playing
description: Music widget: spinning vinyl art, bouncing equalizer, live progress and a play↔pause morphing icon.
a11y: Labelled transport buttons; progress is a progressbar; motion stops when paused or reduced.
prompt: Create a now-playing card: cover art inside a vinyl disc rotating while playing, 4 equalizer bars with looping heights, progress bar and elapsed/remaining time ticking each second, previous/next buttons and a play button whose icon morphs triangle↔bars by animating path `d`.

name: World Clock
description: Analog clocks per time zone with a smooth sweeping second hand and a digital caption.
a11y: role=img labelled with the time; reduced motion ticks once per second instead of sweeping.
perf: One rAF per clock (cheap style updates).
prompt: Make an analog world clock: Intl.DateTimeFormat parts for the zone, hands rotated by hour·30 + minute/2, minute·6, second·6 (+ms for a smooth sweep via rAF), 12 tick marks, an orange seconds hand and center cap.

name: Battery Level
description: Battery with a sloshing liquid fill that springs to the level, colors by charge, and a pulsing bolt while charging.
a11y: role=meter with value and label; status text ('Charging', 'Low power').
perf: Fill height spring + looping wave transform.
prompt: Create a battery widget: a rounded battery outline whose fill springs to the level (red ≤20, amber ≤50, green), with an SVG wave strip on top translating horizontally for a liquid look and a pulsing ⚡ when charging.

name: Countdown Timer
description: Countdown ring that drains smoothly, with start/pause/reset and a celebratory pulse when time is up.
a11y: role=timer display; completion announced via an aria-live region.
perf: One timeout per second; ring pathLength tween.
prompt: Build a countdown timer: SVG ring (pathLength 1) animating to left/total linearly each second, mm:ss in the center, play/pause and reset buttons; at zero the ring turns green, label says Done! and the card pulses scale [1,1.04,1] on repeat.

name: Mini Calendar
description: Month calendar where the selected-day pill glides between dates, months slide in their travel direction, and event dots mark days.
a11y: Day buttons labelled with date and event; aria-pressed for the selection.
perf: Shared layoutId pill; month swap via popLayout.
prompt: Create a mini calendar: header with month name and prev/next buttons; a 7-column grid (Monday first) that slides ±60px on month change (custom direction); selected day highlighted by a layoutId pill (snappy spring); event days show a dot; below, the selected day's event fades in.

name: Live Stock Ticker
description: Ticker card with a streaming sparkline, a price that flashes green/red on each change, and a delta badge.
a11y: Chart has role=img with a label; color is paired with ▲/▼ glyphs.
prompt: Build a live ticker card: keep a rolling 40-point series updated every 900ms; draw an area + polyline sparkline green or red by overall delta; the price text flashes a tinted background that fades out on each change; ▲/▼ percentage badge.

name: Animated Terminal
description: Terminal that types its commands character by character and reveals output lines with a beat in between.
a11y: role=log; reduced motion shows all lines immediately.
prompt: Create an animated terminal window (traffic lights, title): a step machine types each `cmd` line at 40ms/char with a block caret, pauses 350ms, then reveals each output line after 220ms (slide-in), with tone colors (ok/muted/warn).

name: File Tree
description: Collapsible file tree with smooth height animation, rotating chevrons and open/closed folder icons.
a11y: tree / treeitem / group roles with aria-expanded and aria-selected.
prompt: Build a recursive file tree (role=tree): folders toggle with a chevron that springs to 90° and children animate height 0↔auto (250ms); files are selectable; folder icon switches open/closed.

name: Notification Feed
description: New notifications drop in at the top on a loop, pushing older ones down — the animated list for social proof and dashboards.
perf: Max N items; layout animation on insert.
prompt: Create an animated notification list: every interval prepend the next notification (cycling) and cap the list; items enter from y −24 with scale .9, siblings shift via layout springs, exits scale out.

name: Water Tracker
description: Hydration tracker: a glass fills with a wobbling wave as you log cups, with bubbles rising on each change.
a11y: role=meter with value; labelled add/remove buttons.
prompt: Build a water tracker: a glass shape whose water height springs (70/12) to cups/goal, an SVG wave strip looping horizontally on top, and five bubbles that rise and fade each time the value changes; +/− buttons.

name: iPhone Mockup
description: Pure-CSS iPhone frame — titanium bezel, Dynamic Island and side buttons — that wraps any screen or screenshot.
a11y: Frame is presentational; give screenshots meaningful alt text.
perf: No images for the frame; 0 KB JS.
prompt: Build a CSS iPhone mockup: 9:19.5 aspect, titanium gradient outer bezel with drop shadow, side buttons as small bars, black inner bezel, rounded screen that clips children, and a pill-shaped Dynamic Island overlay.

name: Browser Mockup
description: Safari-style window chrome — traffic lights and a centered URL bar with lock — around any content.
a11y: Presentational chrome; content keeps its own semantics.
prompt: Create a browser window mockup: rounded card with a toolbar (three traffic-light dots, centered URL pill with a lock icon) and a content slot.

name: Laptop Mockup
description: CSS laptop — lid with notch, 16:10 screen, hinge and base — for hero shots of web apps.
prompt: Build a laptop mockup in CSS: dark lid with notch around a 16:10 screen slot, and a wider gradient base with a thumb notch and soft shadow.

name: macOS Window
description: A macOS app window that zooms open from its dock icon and minimizes back into it.
a11y: Window is a labelled dialog; traffic lights and dock icon are labelled buttons.
prompt: Create a macOS window + dock icon: the window (origin bottom) enters from scale .2 / y 160 to rest with a spring and exits to scale .15 / y 200 when a traffic light is clicked; clicking the dock icon toggles it; a dot under the icon shows it's open.
